explanation: OEIS A038107 (number of primes < n²), Z.-W. Sun: 'All the numbers Sum_{i=j,...,k} 1/a(i) with 1 < j <= k have pairwise distinct fractional parts.' a(i) ≥ 2 for i ≥ 2, so the sums are well defined. The formal statement (equal fractional parts of the sums for (j, k), (j', k') with 1 < j ≤ k, 1 < j' ≤ k' forces j = j' and k = k') is that injectivity, computed in ℝ. Faithful.
